meta.title: {name}: 3D armor layout
meta.description: Interactive 3D armor layout of the {name}: effective armor, ricochets, spaced armor and penetration by the chosen shell at any range.

page.sourceTitle: Geometry, armor, modules and shells come from the Mir Tankov (Lesta Games) client, build {client}
page.intro: An interactive armor layout: effective armor, spaced plates, ricochets and penetration with the chosen shell at any distance. The tank’s specs are on the <link>tank page</link>.

states.emptyDescription: This vehicle has no armor geometry yet. It will appear after the next data update.
states.errorTitle: Could not load the armor model
states.errorDescription: The server didn't answer. Try again in a minute.

attribution.lesta: Armor geometry and characteristics: © Lesta Games, all rights reserved.
attribution.geometry: Collision geometry from the <link>{repo}</link> mirror of the Mir Tankov client (Lesta branch), commit {commit}.
attribution.note: Only the simplified collision model is shown, with no visual models or textures.

controls.canvas: 3D armor model. Arrow keys rotate the camera, plus and minus zoom, Home returns to the front view.
controls.hint: Hover the armor to see its effective thickness.

legend.title: Legend
legend.heNote: HE compares penetration with nominal armor; the angle is ignored.

quota.remaining: 3D views left: {remaining} of {limit}. The allowance renews on {date}.
quota.signIn: Sign in with Lesta ID for {count} views a month

limit.title: This month's free 3D views are used up
limit.anonymous: Without signing in you can open {limit, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}} in 3D. Sign in with Lesta ID to get {free} views a month, or go unlimited with Plus. The tank page stays free.
limit.free: You have opened {limit, plural, one {# vehicle} other {# vehicles}} in 3D this month, which is the free allowance. It renews on {date}, and vehicles you opened in the last day can still be viewed again. Plus makes 3D armor unlimited.

attack.ownNote: This vehicle’s own gun is firing now. Pick any vehicle to test the armor with its shells.
attack.foreignNote: Shells and penetration come from the chosen vehicle’s game data. No 3D view is spent.
attack.error: Could not load the attacker’s guns. Try picking it again.

heatmap.description: Colors the armor by penetration chance for the chosen shell from the current view and range.
heatmap.legend: Penetration chance from the current view
heatmap.note: Penetration spread is treated as a normal distribution cut off at ±the spread. Only the plate the ray meets is counted; spaced armor and layers behind it are in the hover readout.

compare.note: The second vehicle opens as a regular 3D view and counts toward the monthly limit. Camera and firing settings are shared by both.

zones.title: Key zone armor — table
zones.caption: A shot straight from the front, side and rear at the center of the hull and turret, with the chosen shell at the chosen range.
zones.captionNoShell: The chosen gun has no shells: only nominal armor and angle are shown.
